title: Cadiz Inc. Statement on the U.S. Bureau of Reclamation’s Final Decision on the Colorado River 10-Year Operating Plan
summary: Cadiz Inc. Statement on the U.S. Bureau of Reclamation’s Final Decision on the Colorado River 10-Year Operating Plan
body_markdown:
Cadiz Inc. (NASDAQ:CDZI/CDZIP) issued the following statement supporting[Gov. Newsom’s comments](https://www.gov.ca.gov/2026/08/21/governor-newsom-issues-statement-on-federal-colorado-river-plan/) on the federal government’s release of its final Record of Decision for the Coordinated Operations of the Colorado River (2027–2036) on August 21, 2026. The statement can be attributed to Cathryn Rivera, Chief Operating Officer of Cadiz:


“Gov. Newsom is right: the Colorado River plan buys time, but it provides only short-term stability for a river that 40 million Americans depend on. California has already reduced its Colorado River water use to the lowest level since 1949, even as climate change threatens a regional water crisis.


“Developing new, reliable supplies is the next immediate step to support people and communities impacted by the Colorado River crisis. The Mojave Groundwater Bank is a large-scale solution that can deliver clean, affordable water. The Colorado River cannot carry the Southwest alone anymore. The Southwest needs stable, new water supplies, and the Mojave Groundwater Bank is the project that can deliver it.”


To learn more about the Record of Decision for the Coordinated Operations of the Colorado River (2027–2036), visit the[U.S. Bureau of Reclamation’s website](https://www.usbr.gov/ColoradoRiverBasin/post2026/decision-doc/index.html) .
